html:
Ho Chi Minh to Vung Tau transfer in a comfortable car and professional driver is the best choice for all people who stay in Ho Chi Minh City or just landing at Tan Son Nhat Airport.

The distance from Saigon to Vung Tau is about 103km, and it takes us around 3 hours to transfer by car. Unlike other Saigon to Vung Tau transport, such as traditional taxis or grab cars, our private car hire from Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau offers a door to door service at a reasonable price with top quality.

HO CHI MINH TO VUNG TAU BY PRIVATE CAR

Vietlook Travel offers 24/7 customer care service, and our travel experts are willing to customize the itinerary by listening to your requests. For a private car Saigon to Vung Tau transfer, you can choose the departure time that suits your convenience. You can also request that we pick you up at Tan Son Nhat International Airport.

Please provide us with your hotel names for pickup and drop off in Saigon and Vung Tau, the number of people/ luggage, your travel day, and the pickup time.

For Saigon Airport to Vung Tau, just tell us the additional info such as the flight number/ landing time so our travel agents can track your flight and send the proper car/ driver to pick you up at Tan Son Nhat Airport.

With our service standards, our experienced driver will give you a hand with luggage, remind you to get all the passports, and always double-check the car to ensure you forget nothing before saying goodbye to our customers.

To ensure you have a smooth transfer from Ho Chi Minh to Vung Tau, we will keep in touch with you via WhatsApp at +84343662242 before, during, and after the transfer.

Along the way from Ho Chi Minh City to Vung Tau, our friendly driver will stop at some rest stops for you to take a short break, drink some coffee, or simply use the toilets.

Upon arrival at your hotel/ resort in Vung Tau, our driver will drop you off at the lobby and we finish the Ho Chi Minh to Vung Tau by private car. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great private transfer with us.

Why Travel With Us?

  • This is a door-to-door private car transfer.
  • Our driver team is well-trained, professional, and can speak basic English.
  • We offer new, modern, and convenient vehicles with a strong A/C.
  • The private car Vung Tau to Saigon transfer is always available.
  • Our price is very clear and reasonable to all customers and there are no hidden fees.
  • We provide 24/7/365 customer care service to ensure our travel agents can support you instantly.
  • You can deposit half and pay the balance to our driver when you reach your hotel in Vung Tau.
